payload.claim: This line, added by the diff, states that `saffron package` runs inside both built images (cell-base and proxy), but `package()`'s re-verification only starts gate-only cells (`saffron/phases/package.py`'s `reverify`/`_gate_cell`, via `worktree.prepare_worktree`), which never call `proxy.start_proxy` and never reference the proxy image at all. A gate-only cell is defined to carry no proxy, so the proxy image this section tells an operator to build is not something `saffron package` ever touches, and the documented requirement is false for the command this diff adds.
